email_body:
Hi Quilon,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to an advertised vacancy. I found your details in JBA's capability statement and wanted to reach you directly about graduate civil design or drafting work in your civil team.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your civil work on site works, roads, earthworks, pavement design and drainage is the work I trained for. My drafting so far is from study, not a paid role.

Would you be open to a short chat, or to passing this to whoever leads your civil team? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I am writing to ask whether JBA Consulting Engineers has room for a graduate civil designer or drafter. This is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advertised role.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer I prepared site reports, material records and progress reports and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

JBA's civil work on site works, roads, earthworks, pavement design and drainage infrastructure is what I trained for. I live in Melton, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My drafting experience is from study rather than a paid role, so I would value mentoring from your team.
I have attached my resume. Thank you for considering my enquiry.
